title: Ephemeral tenant bellows and soft egress gate hotfix
author: Asha Patel
commits: fix(egress): introduce EphemeralTenantBellows to smooth burst egress pressure
fix(slo): reserve transient-slo tokens during bellows warmup
perf(backpressure): add soft egress gate with graded-shed strategy and quick-unwind
docs: add telemetry keys and dashboard links
test: unit + integration for bellows and soft gate behavior
description:
Context: We saw multiple short-lived tenant surges over 2025-03-10..11 that triggered aggressive regional circuit flips and wholesale egress denies for affected tenants. Root cause: tightly-coupled egress admission + immediate SLO reclamation caused oscillation during bursty traffic patterns (short high QPS spikes).

Motivation: Introduce a short-lived, in-memory smoothing mechanism (EphemeralTenantBellows) to absorb transient egress bursts without tripping regional circuits, and add a Soft Egress Gate that performs graded shedding and fast unwind. Combined with a small SLO reservation window for bursts, this reduces circuit flapping and avoids heavy regional failovers while still protecting cluster capacity.

What this PR does (summary):
- Adds EphemeralTenantBellows (serving/egress/bellows.go): per-tenant ring-of-tokens that absorbs short spikes up to configured capacity and drains with an exponential cooldown.
- Adds Soft Egress Gate (serving/egress/gate.go): layered shedding policy (pass -> probablistic-shed -> drop) with fast-unwind when healthy. Integrates with existing circuit state machine but keeps state ephemeral.
- SLO reservation (serving/slo/reservation.go): reserve transient tokens during bellows warmup; reconciliation logic ensures reservations don't exceed tenant commit limits.
- Telemetry: new metrics (egress_bellows_fill, egress_gate_mode, egress_shed_rate), dashboard JSON, and tracing spans on gate decisions.
- Config: defaults.yaml introduces two new knobs (bellows_capacity_ms, soft_gate_window_ms).
- Tests: unit and integration tests simulate tenant spike patterns and assert no circuit flip and bounded latency regressions.
- Docs: operational runbook with rollback steps and observability notes.

Checklist:
- [x] Unit tests for bellows token accounting
- [x] Integration tests exercising regional failover under synthetic bursts
- [x] Telemetry wired and dashboard added
- [x] Config knobs validated against default cluster profile
- [x] Hotfix branch, targeted rollout plan included

Rollout plan: immediate canary to a single low-risk region for 2 hours, monitor egress_bellows_fill, egress_gate_mode, regional_circuit_reopens. If metrics show increased shed_rate or SLO regressions beyond thresholds (SRE-77), revert by disabling soft_gate via config flag (steps in docs).

Why unique: Instead of raising global throttles we introduce a short-duration smoothing layer that keeps tenant requests in-path (reduced latency compared to fallback) but protects capacity through graded shedding and SLO reservations. This is intended to be surgical and reversible (config-driven).

Related: Incident SUP-4321, ENG-2034 (design doc), SRE runbook edits included in docs/operational.
review_comments: Daniel Zhou (2025-03-12): The bellows data structure is clever. Concern: what's the worst-case memory growth when many tenants spike concurrently? Can we bound the in-memory footprint per-region?

Asha Patel (2025-03-12): Reply: bellows is sharded and uses a fixed-size token ring per active tenant; we add an LRU eviction for idle tenants. Max memory per-region is capped by bellows_capacity_shard_count * token_size; details in comments in bellows.go

Lena Moretti (2025-03-13): Can we expose a debug endpoint that samples tenant bellows state for live incident debugging? Also please add a short lived metric that counts LRU evictions so we can tune capacity.
Asha Patel (2025-03-13): Reply: added egress_bellows_evictions metric and debug endpoint at /debug/egress/bellows (behind feature flag).
Omar Haddad (2025-03-14): Verified integration tests and canary results locally. Approving for squash-merge once CI is green and docs link is present.
Daniel Zhou (2025-03-14): Minor nit: tighten unit test timing to reduce flakiness (done).
release_notes: Hotfix: introduce ephemeral egress smoothing (EphemeralTenantBellows) and a Soft Egress Gate to reduce circuit flips during short tenant bursts. Adds metrics and a canary rollout plan. Reversible via config. Impact: reduces regional failovers for bursty tenants.
